adaptationRules.naming: Each retained baseline path maps one-to-one to a stable public Swift symbol recorded by the native declaration manifest. Swift spelling may follow native conventions, but paths may not be merged, omitted or mapped to silent no-ops.
adaptationRules.shape: The pinned declaration text and SHA identify baseline fields, overloads, optionality and callable shape. Swift replaces structural TypeScript syntax with typed enum, struct, protocol, closure, async and throws forms while preserving every observable value and callback contract.
adaptationRules.domAndEvents: HTMLElement and DOM widget positions become typed AppKit NSView protocols; browser keyboard, mouse and scroll objects become immutable Mona native event snapshots.
adaptationRules.promiseAndDisposable: Thenable and Promise become async or Task; IDisposable becomes MonaDisposable with deterministic idempotent disposal.
adaptationRules.dynamicValues: any and open object maps are narrowed only where the accepted cuts remove JavaScript source compatibility; retained behaviors receive explicit tagged native values and may not become silent no-ops.
adaptationRules.typeSystemHelpers: Mapped, conditional, keyof, infer and typeof helper aliases with no independent runtime value or data shape are absent from Swift. Their consumer APIs retain typed native signatures and observable semantics.
adaptationRules.memberCuts: The 11 accepted editor option cuts remain member-level cuts in otherwise retained declarations and are inherited from F1-R3 scope manifest.

f1r3LspDisposition.reason: L2-R2 fixes MonaMessageTransport as the core boundary and host injection as transport ownership; iframe, Worker and concrete WebSocket constructors conflict with that architecture and the accepted DOM/WebWorker cuts.

overrides.topLevelWorker: The d.ts exports worker as a type namespace, but it is absent from the 19-key runtime object; the entire three-interface namespace is cut with createWebWorker.
overrides.deprecatedLanguagePackAliases: languages.css/html/json/typescript are d.ts-only deprecated declarations and absent from the 57-key runtime object; the four builtin language packs are already cut.

closureRule: All 555 public declaration paths, including every member of the four cut builtin language-pack namespaces, all five TypeScript-only option type helpers and all three JavaScript global augmentations, have one disposition. Every retained path must appear in the native public declaration manifest with a non-no-op semantic mapping. Every cut path must be absent. Runtime values remain independently set-equal to the F1-R3 runtime scope after applying the explicit F1-R4 overrides.
productStatus: Design scope artifact only. No native public declaration manifest or conformance result exists.
